selection: Three previously unmeasured local BAL instances in three familiar dataset families, chosen before downloading or running; correlated family data, not independent capture domains. Sizes bound storage and runtime. No tuning.
ablation_scope: all three scenes at primary target, including inactive controls; no outcome-driven scene substitution
calibration: N3 guard-off Prism and Caspar FP64, 15 native seconds/600 outers, minimum independently audited endpoint, then freeze all targets before timing; calibration excluded from timings
precision: original FP64 observations and common SIMPLE_RADIAL objective k2 fixed zero, independent FP64 exported-state audit
timers: native solve including Prism local setup; external graph setup separately recorded; process wall includes loading/export excluded from native. CPU and GPU solvers serialized with local GPU lock.
curvature_criterion: Curvature size must improve time at equal hit rate by >=1.10x on at least two guard-active instances and avoid >1.10x slowdown on any; otherwise no promotion or extra novelty claim. If fewer than two active instances, evidence insufficient.
limitations: Three new instances do not establish universal fastest
Ceres is CPU baseline, not evidence versus all GPU solvers
Existing Caspar snapshots are pinned implementations, not assertion of latest upstream
